description: "welcome to the Starry Tales! I am participating solo to weave the wonders of the universe into beautiful space stories . My goal is to blend creative imagination with space exploration and share the magic of the cosmos."
summary: Forgotten tales of moom & mars in an interactive storytelling project designe dto introduce school age space enthusiasts to the real life journeys of NASA discarded hardware on the moon and mars. since the 1960 numerous , SPACECRAFTS, ROVERS and  landers such  as OPPORTUNITY have  completed historic missions and remained on these world. our project brings their stories to life through engaging visual narratives and real NASA mission facts. by turning space history and planetary exploration into fun, relatable adventure, it addresses the challenge of making complex space science accessible and inspiring for kids .
